emma: Heads up — RetailBank POC blocked. They see intermittent DNS resolution and TLS validation failures when calling our PrivateLink hostname. Need quick swarm.

diego: Is this an AWS interface endpoint in their account? Any flow logs or ENI IPs?

emma: Yes, vpce in their account. ENI IPs: 10.0.16.9 and 10.0.16.10. Their app shows:
```
$ dig +short retail-api.local @10.0.0.5
# sometimes returns 10.0.16.9, sometimes empty
$ curl -v https://retail-api.local/health
* Connected to 10.0.16.9
* TLS handshake: certificate signed by "Corp-Intercept-CA"
* SSL: certificate verify failed: issuer not known
```
They also pasted a VPC flow line with REJECTs to dstport=443.

priya: Two parallel issues: conditional forwarder timeouts causing NXDOMAIN and a corporate TLS inspection proxy resigning certs. Ask them to check forwarder health and whether the proxy can bypass this hostname.

diego: Also REJECT indicates SG/NACL blocking or endpoint policy denying. Can they run `aws ec2 describe-network-interfaces` and share the SG ids?

emma: They shared SG sg-0f1a which allows 443 from their app CIDR. No NACL changes. Their DNS admin says the conditional forwarder timeouts under load, causing intermittent empties.

priya: Short remediation for demo: 1) Temporarily allowlist a static EIP we allocate so traffic bypasses their perimeter proxy path, 2) increase forwarder reliability or point retail-api.local to our resolver during demo, 3) relax endpoint policy if present.

infra-bot: Action queued: allocate-temp-eip -> started.

emma: Customer prefers least changes on their side. If we hand them an EIP they can allowlist destination and avoid TLS inspection.

infra-bot: Allocation complete: EIP 18.212.77.200, nat-id nat-07a1b2c3.

diego: Provide EIP and ask them to allowlist dest 18.212.77.200:443 and confirm resolver now returns ENI IP or use `--resolve` for the demo. Also include checklist for endpoint policy and SG.

emma: Sent EIP + checklist. Customer retested with `--resolve` and reported success:
```
$ dig +short retail-api.local @10.0.0.5
10.0.16.9
$ curl -v --resolve "retail-api.local:443:10.0.16.9" https://retail-api.local/health
* TLS handshake completed
{"status":"ok"}
```

priya: Great. Follow-ups: document permanent options (PrivateLink with dedicated peering, PKI onboarding so proxy trusts our chain, or customer proxy bypass rules). Sales: Priya or Diego will send pricing for Dedicated/peering.

diego: I'll draft a short runbook and pricing note. Close swarm after runbook attached to the ticket.

emma: Closing — demo scheduled next week. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
